# Monolithic.org

> Monolithic.org is the comprehensive resource for Monolithic Dome construction technology, featuring innovative building systems that deliver disaster-resistant, energy-efficient structures across residential, commercial, and institutional applications.

Monolithic specializes in the Airform construction method using steel rebar, polyurethane foam, and shotcrete to create durable dome and shell structures. The site covers diverse applications from homes and schools to storage facilities and sports arenas, with guidance on design, construction techniques, and real-world case studies.

## Key Topics

- Monolithic Dome
- Airform technology
- Dome construction
- EcoShells

## Core Products & Technology

- [The Monolithic Dome](https://www.monolithic.org/domes): Monolithic Domes construction using Airform, steel rebar, and polyurethane foam
- [Monolithic Products and Manufacturing](https://www.monolithic.org/products): Monolithic products including Airform, Domes, Crenospheres, and EcoShells
- [Monolithic Ecoshells](https://www.monolithic.org/ecoshells): EcoShells I and II thin-shell concrete structures using Airform technology

## Residential & Housing Applications

- [Monolithic Dome Homes](https://www.monolithic.org/homes): Monolithic Dome residential homes with custom design and energy efficiency
- [Monolithic Dome Rentals](https://www.monolithic.org/rentals): Monolithic Dome rental housing with affordable, secure living units

## Institutional & Community Buildings

- [Monolithic Dome Schools](https://www.monolithic.org/schools): Monolithic Dome schools exceeding FEMA safety requirements for education
- [Monolithic Dome Churches](https://www.monolithic.org/churches): Monolithic Dome churches from chapels to megachurches with cost savings
- [Monolithic Dome Sports Facilities](https://www.monolithic.org/sports): Monolithic Dome sports facilities for gymnasiums, arenas, and stadiums

## Industrial & Commercial Applications

- [Commercial Monolithic Dome Structures](https://www.monolithic.org/commercial): Commercial Monolithic Domes for factories, offices, and industrial use
- [Monolithic Dome Bulk Storage](https://www.monolithic.org/storages): Monolithic Dome bulk storage for grains, fertilizer, cement, and goods

## Design & Construction Guidance

- [Design](https://www.monolithic.org/design): Dome design guidelines, structural engineering, and safety considerations
- [How To…](https://www.monolithic.org/how-to): How-to guides for dome construction, finishing, ERV installation, and maintenance

## News & Community

- [News](https://www.monolithic.org/news-feed): Monolithic News updates on domes, tornado shelters, and disaster resilience
